title: Insert a title before a clip on its track, and change the transition between them like any cut
goal: Putting a title page in front of a recording must be one move: pick the clip, double click a title in the Library (or drag it onto the clip's track before the clip), and the title goes on the SAME track right before the clip, the clip and everything after it moving along to make room. The join between title and clip is a real transition on the timeline that the person can see, click to pick, right-click to change (Cross Dissolve, Dip to Black, Cube, Flip, Push...) or Delete to make a straight cut. The fade the title has today is not baked in: it IS that transition.

Code: titles are inserted on their own Title tracks as overlays (EditorState+TitlePresets.swift insertTitle :108-120) so no edit point exists between a title and a clip; transitions live at edit points (EditPointTransitions.swift) and cuts (ClipTransitions.swift); the title's fade out is a key written by TitlePresets/ClipKeys. Related: 3d-transitions-and-title-entrances (done), a-title-page-s-parts-each-have-their-own-labelle (in progress).
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults: insert a title page, move a recording to follow it, try to change the title-to-clip transition to Cube, try to drag the title onto the clip's track; record each failure (today titles go on their own Title track as overlays and there is no join between a title and a clip)

A title page (full frame title) can live on a video track as a clip in the sequence, like a recording: dragging it onto a video track before or after a clip places it in the sequence there (ripple inserting), and the drop shows where it will land and what will move; overlay titles and name cards still go on Title tracks above

With a clip picked, double clicking a title page in the Library (or Insert > Title Page) inserts it on the picked clip's track immediately before that clip, rippling the clip and everything after it on that track (and linked sound) later by the title's length; one undo step

The join between the title and the clip is a transition at an edit point exactly like a join between two clips: drawn on the timeline as a visible band, hover highlights it, click picks it, right-click offers the transition list (2D and 3D) with length and curve, Delete removes it (a straight cut). The title's own 'fade out' is no longer a key baked into the title: it becomes this transition (default Cross Dissolve), and the title's out build only animates its parts

Transitions declare how they join: overlapping ones (dissolve, cube, flip, push) overlap the two clips by their length, using the title's tail and the clip's head; non-overlapping ones (dip to black or white, with an optional hold) put the dip between them; the timeline shows which, and changing kind adjusts the clips (ripple) without leaving gaps
A title with no handle frames still takes an overlapping transition (titles are generated, so they can always extend), and a recording without spare frames offers to shorten itself as cuts already do

A walk picks a recording, double clicks a title page, checks it landed before the clip on the same track with the clip moved later, right-clicks the join, picks Cube, plays through it, deletes the transition, and checks a straight cut
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.
